## Description

A spherical colony (20–60 µm of mucilage) of 8–16 tightly packed green cells of 8–17 µm, each with two
flagella pointing out; it rolls while swimming towards light.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 4 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [compact colony](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#other-colonies) releasing daughter colonies; phototactic.
No measured speed: that of *Gonium*.

## Not implemented yet

- 4 daughter colonies instead of one per cell.
- No sexual reproduction (isogamous gametes).

## Unique and shared mechanics

The step between *Gonium* and *Eudorina* in the volvocine series.
